$comment: PF-70 flaky-test quarantine. Tests listed here still run on every PR in the quarantine (*) jobs, which show on the PR but are not inputs to ci-ok (the blocking gate). Removing an entry and its ci.yml exclude puts the test back in the blocking jobs. Do not skip, delete, or weaken the test. Follow-up cards: PF-76 (M1-AC16), PF-77 (LH mobile TBT/perf), PF-78 (WebKit phone LCP), PF-79 (B-4 idle), PF-80 (Chromium visible-jump), PF-81 (WebKit loader exit frames; PF-75 rewrote the checks, still 47/50 on WebKit x10), PF-82 (a11y 150 ms stepped-backdrop).

items.title: PF-75 AC1: ready before 300 ms (early) never shows the iris, on any frame, and the cover fades over 240 ms
items.reason: WebKit CI frame starvation on the early exit: 'cover fades over its 240 ms exit' saw 1.00 to 0 with no mid-fade frame (2-4 rAF per exit on the CPU-raster runner). 1 of 10 in loader-repeat x10. Assertions unchanged.

items.title: PF-75 AC2: ready after the iris is in opens it in 600 ms from where it is (hole grows, rim holds then fades)
items.reason: WebKit CI frame starvation in the 600 ms open: no frame painted the hidden state before removal ('hidden NaN - open start'). 1 of 10 in loader-repeat x10 at 3ec2c93 (9 of 10 before the PF-75 paint fixes). Assertions unchanged.

items.title: PF-67 AC1: a page that never gets ready starts its open at the 2.6 s cap and is gone by 3.2 s
items.reason: WebKit CI frame starvation in the capped open: last visible frame 3.2 s + one 345 ms frame. 1 of 10 in loader-repeat x10. Assertions unchanged.

items.reason: Known recurring flake: the 150 ms step-end CSS blink plant is deferred as live canvas on SwiftShader instead of fail/undecided. Seen on PR #34, #40, PF-54 root-fix attempt, PF-69 QA a2, and PF-73 run 44300131182 (att.1+2). The 2400 ms sibling plants stay blocking. Assertions unchanged.
